_urlsHelp: Each entry in 'urls' can be a remote stream URL (https://...m3u8 / .mpd / .mp4) or the file name of a video inside Assets/StreamingAssets (just the name, no folder).
_ambisonicHelp: ambisonicAudio: 0 NONE, 1 AMBIX_4Ch, 2 AMBIX_4Ch+2HeadLocked, 3 AMBIX_9Ch, 4 AMBIX_9Ch+2HeadLocked, 5 AMBIX_16Ch, 6 AMBIX_16Ch+2HeadLocked, 7 TBE_4Ch, 8 TBE_4Ch+2HeadLocked, 9 TBE_6Ch, 10 TBE_6Ch+2HeadLocked, 11 TBE_8Ch, 12 TBE_8Ch+2HeadLocked
_drmHelp: Set enableDRM to true for encrypted streams. keyServerURI/tokenKey/tokenValue apply to every entry in 'urls'. Use 'contents' to give an entry its own license server or token. tokenKey/tokenValue are an optional license request header (Android/Widevine only).
